components.name: Service row
components.description: Visual specimen of the React accordion row; production uses a button with aria-expanded and a labelled controlled region.
components.css: .ds-service{border-block:1px solid var(--bt-line,#d9cec1);max-width:520px}.ds-service button{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:23px 0;border:0;background:none;color:var(--bt-burgundy,#4b242b);font:400 32px var(--bt-serif,"Libre Caslon Display",Georgia,serif);text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-service button:hover{color:#986149}.ds-service button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a35839;outline-offset:6px}.ds-service svg{width:22px;height:22px;transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-service button[aria-expanded="true"] svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-service svg{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-address{padding:38px 42px;border:1px solid #baa591;outline:1px solid #d9cabb;outline-offset:-8px;background:#f4eddf;max-width:390px}.ds-address p{margin:0;color:var(--bt-burgundy,#4b242b);font:400 30px var(--bt-serif,"Libre Caslon Display",Georgia,serif)}.ds-address address{margin-top:25px;color:#674e43;font:400 13px/1.9 "DM Sans",sans-serif}.ds-address a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-top:21px;color:var(--bt-ink,#3e3030);font:400 12px "DM Sans",sans-serif;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:#ad9385;text-underline-offset:5px}.ds-address a:hover{text-decoration-color:currentColor}.ds-address a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a35839;outline-offset:6px}.ds-address svg{width:17px;height:17px}

components.css: .ds-mobile-contact{display:flex;padding:0 18px;background:var(--bt-burgundy,#4b242b);color:var(--bt-cream,#f7f3eb);box-shadow:0 -4px 16px #2a16121a;font:400 11px "DM Sans",sans-serif}.ds-mobile-contact a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:58px;flex:1;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-mobile-contact a+a{border-left:1px solid #79555a}.ds-mobile-contact a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--bt-cream,#f7f3eb);outline-offset:-6px}.ds-mobile-contact a:first-child{flex:1.35}

components.name: Dress stage controls
components.description: Three manual fitting stages with pressed states; the app swaps the portrait and announces the current description.
components.css: .ds-dress-stages{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));border-bottom:1px solid #cab4a6;background:var(--bt-cream,#f7f3eb)}.ds-dress-stages button{position:relative;min-height:65px;background:none;border:0;text-align:left;font:400 11px/1.45 "DM Sans",sans-serif;padding:7px 8px 13px;color:#79625a;cursor:pointer}.ds-dress-stages span{display:block;font:400 17px var(--bt-serif,"Libre Caslon Display",Georgia,serif);margin-bottom:4px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-dress-stages button::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-1px;height:2px;width:100%;background:var(--bt-burgundy,#4b242b);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-dress-stages button[aria-pressed=true]{color:var(--bt-burgundy,#4b242b)}.ds-dress-stages button[aria-pressed=true]::after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-dress-stages button:hover{color:var(--bt-burgundy,#4b242b);background:#eee5dc}.ds-dress-stages button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a35839;outline-offset:-3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-dress-stages button::after{transition:none}}

components.name: Fitting request field
components.description: Square cream field with a visible required label and 16px entry text, used by the local-only request preview.
components.html: Preview only. Nothing is sent or booked.
components.css: .ds-fitting-field{background:#eee5d7;padding:22px;max-width:480px;color:var(--bt-burgundy,#4b242b)}.ds-fitting-field label{display:block;margin-bottom:9px;font:500 12px/1.5 "DM Sans",sans-serif}.ds-fitting-field label span{font-size:10px;font-weight:400;color:#67554b}.ds-fitting-field input{display:block;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:48px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #ac9585;border-radius:0;background:var(--bt-cream,#f7f3eb);color:var(--bt-ink,#3e3030);font:400 16px/1.5 "DM Sans",sans-serif;caret-color:var(--bt-burgundy,#4b242b);transition:border-color .2s}.ds-fitting-field input:hover{border-color:#76564c}.ds-fitting-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #873f2a;outline-offset:3px}.ds-fitting-field p{margin:12px 0 0;font:400 11px/1.7 "DM Sans",sans-serif;color:#67554b}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-fitting-field input{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: This record applies only to Sue’s Tailor Shop at `/demo/sues-tailor`. The prior `/demo/best-tailor` alias and internal source and asset paths remain available. It captures the user-approved direction and the implemented CSS and React behavior, without changing the Wallace Shift design system. The current direction is feminine and focused on dresses, with the warmth of a neighborhood boutique. The composition is led by code: a large serif promise and fitting request action sit beside three illustrative dress stages. Wedding dress copy invites discussion of a particular garment; the imagery does not establish custom gown services or actual client results.
keyCharacteristics: Three illustrative dress-fitting stages and a fine needle-and-thread mark.
Warm ivory, soft blush surfaces, deep burgundy, and restrained copper-brown accents.
Expressive serif headings paired with small, calm sans-serif utility text.
Open sections and ruled service rows, with subtle motion tied to interaction.
dos: Do preserve the feminine dress-focused boutique direction, serif and sans-serif pairing, square controls, and fine tailoring mark.
Do keep the fitting request, call action, and appointment-only language easy to find on narrow screens.
Do preserve the illustrative image disclosure and the user-requested absence of visible Wallace Shift attribution.
donts: Don't represent the generated dress stages as the shop's actual work or promise custom gown creation.
Don't imply the local preview sends an appointment request or reserves a fitting.
Don't turn the review selector into an automatic carousel or add motion that ignores reduced-motion preferences.
